Here, we provide a quick overview of Hamilton-Jacobi reachability analysis, a specific toolbox,
DeepReach, to compute high-dimensional neural reachable tubes, and an iterative scenario-based
method for recovering probabilistically safe tubes from learning-based methods like DeepReach.
